name: mintegral-mcp
description: Mintegral (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, update_budget, pause_resume. Every tool maps to

platform_mcp_mintegral_access_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MINTEGRAL_ACCESS_KEY
platform_mcp_mintegral_access_key.description: Access Key from Mintegral AppGrowth > Account Management > Basic Information; sent as the access-key header of every Open API call.

platform_mcp_mintegral_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MINTEGRAL_API_KEY
platform_mcp_mintegral_api_key.description: API Key from the same Basic Information page; never sent, only used to compute the per-request token = md5(api_key + md5(timestamp)).

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /api/open/v1/account/balance verifies the key pair and answers data.list [{user_id, username, currency, balance}].

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: The only account-level call is Get Account Balance: data.list holds the account(s) the key belongs to with {user_id, username, currency, balance}.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: Lists offers (GET /api/open/v1/offers, at most 50 per page): in Mintegral the offer is the unit that carries budget, bid and RUNNING/STOPPED status, while a 'campaign' is the promoted app; so campaign ids used by update_budget and pause_resume are offer_ids. status filters by offer status (e.g. RUNNING, STOPPED). Budgets are per-region arrays (raw.budget: [{country_code, total_budget, daily_cap_type, daily_cap}]) and are not flattened. account_id is not sent: the access key selects the account. Parameters are sent as a query string (the reference's GET example shows them as a JSON object; the same API's audience list documents them in the query).

tools.name: update_budget
tools.description: PUT /api/open/v1/offer/budget {offer_id, budget: [{country_code: ALL, daily_cap_type: BUDGET, daily_cap, total_budget: OPEN}]} sets one daily spend cap (whole units of the account currency, minimum 50) for all regions of the offer; this spends money, replaces any per-region budgets and leaves the total budget open ('"OPEN" means no budget'). daily_budget must be a whole number; currency is ignored.

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: PUT /api/open/v1/offer/status {offer_id, status: RUNNING|STOPPED} starts or pauses one offer (pause → STOPPED, resume → RUNNING). Resuming restarts spend.
